concerns.text: Task T013 ('tokenize_and_filter.py') is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on the output of T012 ('download_micro_corpus.py'). The task description implies fetching data streams and tokenizing them in the same step, creating a hidden dependency on T012's completion. If T012 fails or is delayed, T013 cannot run. The [P] tag is incorrect for this task as it cannot run in parallel with T012.

Task T014 ('validate_corpus.py') is marked [P] but depends on the output of T013 ('tokenize_and_filter.py'). Validation requires the tokenized corpus to exist. The [P] tag is incorrect; this task must wait for T013 to complete.

Task T015 ('split_data.py') is marked [P] but depends on the output of T014 ('validate_corpus.py'). Splitting requires a validated corpus. The [P] tag is incorrect; this task must wait for T014 to complete.

Task T022 ('train_loop.py') is marked [P] but depends on the output of T020/T021 (model definitions) AND the output of T015 (split data). The training loop cannot be implemented or run without the data artifacts from US1. The [P] tag is incorrect; this task has a cross-story dependency on US1 completion.

Task T029 ('statistical_test.py') is marked [P] but depends on the output of T024 ('run_experiment.py'). The statistical analysis requires the training logs generated by the experiment runner. The [P] tag is incorrect; this task must wait for US2 completion.

Task T030 ('compute_metrics.py') is marked [P] but depends on the output of T029 (ANOVA results) and T031 (HumanEval evaluation). The correlation calculation requires the gap slope from the ANOVA and the HumanEval scores. The [P] tag is incorrect; this task has dependencies on T029 and T031.

Task T031 ('HumanEval evaluation script') is marked [P] but depends on the output of T024 (trained model checkpoints). The evaluation script cannot run without the models trained in US2. The [P] tag is incorrect; this task must wait for US2 completion.
